basic_info.description: This 2BR/2BA Merced Hts home offers classic period charm with a spacious layout and the perfect foundation for your creative vision. Main level features hardwood floors, an updated eat-in kitchen, gas stove, ample storage cabinets, two spacious bedrooms and is the perfect foundation for your personal touch. The charming, spacious living room with FP is surrounded by built-ins. The expansive downstairs area features 1BA, laundry area and sliding doors to a lovely deck. Untapped potential. Back yard awaits a gardener's touch.  The neighborhood is near West Portal with an eclectic mix of local restaurants, cafes, and shops, offering a lively atmosphere. Close to Ocean Ave. shops, Whole Foods and coffee shops. Convenient access to public transportation, MUNI light rail and bus lines to downtown SF in 20 minutes. This home offers an exciting opportunity to own property in a great area, with nearby parks, schools, and community hubs adding to the appeal. Whether you're looking to invest in a rapidly growing neighborhood or settle down and make this house your dream home. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity. Schedule a showing today and explore all the possibilities this property has to offer! Professional photos to follow Monday.
